detail: Neuralink received FDA approval to launch the LINK Pivotal Study, the first pivotal trial for an implantable brain-computer interface in the U.S. for individuals with severe paralysis due to ALS.
why_relevant: As a leading BCI company securing the first U.S. pivotal trial, Neuralink offers premier opportunities for biosignal-ML and neuromodulation engineering interns.

detail: Salvia BioElectronics received €25M in debt funding from the European Investment Bank (EIB).
why_relevant: Salvia develops bioelectronic neuromodulation therapies for chronic neurological conditions, making it an exciting target for a neuromodulation MS BME student.

detail: Lumius raised $4.5 million in seed funding from FundersClub and other investors to take its real-time 3D ultrasound device through FDA clearance.
why_relevant: A Duke spinout building AI-driven real-time imaging for neural and vascular structures aligns well with advanced biosignal-ML and medical device tracking.

detail: WearOptimo raised more than $7 million to further develop its micro-array skin biosensor patch.
why_relevant: WearOptimo's work on high-precision wearable biosensors provides direct exposure to micro-scale health-monitoring hardware and biosignal acquisition.
